versions.title: Redesigned AI Revision Assistant
changes: AI assistant is now fully integrated with the card system — no more chat interface for card generation
Generate questions, Focus on weak cards, and Find gaps now create real flashcards you can add to your set or save as a new one
New AI Quiz mode — generates brand new questions in the familiar quiz format
Explain a card and Revision tips remain as a clean chat interface for back-and-forth help
Card preview screen shows all generated cards before you decide to add them

versions.title: School Year & Changelog Improvements
changes: Set a school year (Y7-Y13) per card set, shown as a badge on the home screen
Default school year setting in Settings
AI Revision Assistant tailors language and difficulty to the school year
Changelog now shows only the latest version with option to expand full history

versions.title: Updates & Changelog
changes: Added automatic and manual update settings
New changelog popup shows what changed after an update
Manual mode adds Check for updates and View changelog buttons in Settings

versions.title: AI Safety & Polish
changes: AI Revision Assistant now stays focused on the current card set only
Added message length limit to AI chat input

versions.title: AI Revision Assistant
changes: New AI Revision Assistant mode powered by Claude
Password-protected access via Cloudflare Worker proxy
Quick actions: Generate questions, Test me, Focus on weak cards, Find gaps, Explain a card, Revision tips

versions.title: Dictation
changes: Added microphone button to card editor — speak your term or definition instead of typing

versions.title: Voice Picker & French Support
changes: Automatic French language detection — switches voice when French text is detected
Voice picker in Settings for English and French voices
Playback speed slider added to Settings

versions.title: Streaks & Text-to-Speech
changes: Study streak counter on home screen
Last-studied date shown on each set card
Text-to-speech speaker button on flashcard and learn mode cards

versions.title: Initial Release
changes: Create and manage multiple card sets with emoji and colour
Archive and unarchive sets
Flashcard, Learn, Quiz and Match study modes
Progress tracking, import, backup and restore
Offline support, no ads, no account required
